C1.source_quote: When the line of fate rises from the wrist and proceeds straight up the hand to its destination on the Mount of Saturn, it is a sign of extreme good fortune and success.

C2.source_quote: The line of head from the commencement of the line of life, and connected with it (d-d, Plate XVI.), indicates a sensitive and more nervous temperament; it denotes excess of caution; even clever people with this mark rein themselves down too tightly.

C3.source_quote: The line of life should be long, narrow, and deep, without irregularities, breaks, or crosses of any kind. Such a formation promises long life, good health, and vitality.

C4.source_quote: Venus be well developed, it indicates strong and robust health.

C5.source_quote: When developed it shows ambition, pride, enthusiasm in anything attempted, and desire for power.

C6.source_quote: This, the first, gives active courage, the martial spirit, but when large, shows a very quarrelsome, fighting disposition.

reading_text:
The line of fate on your hand rises from the wrist and runs straight to the Mount of Saturn. This is a most auspicious sign, indicating extreme good fortune and success in your endeavors. Your head line, which rises from the commencement of the life line and is connected with it, reveals a sensitive and more nervous temperament. This connection suggests an excess of caution, which may lead even the cleverest individuals to restrain themselves too tightly.

Your life line is long, narrow, and deep, without any irregularities. Such a line promises a long life, accompanied by good health and vitality. The Mount of Venus on your hand is well developed, further indicating strong and robust health. Additionally, the Mount of Jupiter is developed, which shows that you possess ambition, pride, and enthusiasm in all that you undertake, along with a desire for power.

The presence of the Upper Mount of Mars on your hand bestows upon you active courage and a martial spirit.

A note on what I have not interpreted: the classical texts I work from do not clearly address the following as they appear in your hands: heart line, sun line, thumb, fingers, mount of saturn, mount of apollo, mount of mercury, mount of mars negative, mount of luna. Rather than guess, I have left these out of your reading.

For major life decisions, I recommend consulting a qualified astrologer or palm reader for a personal reading.
